## Numbered actions

1. Read config/camera_architecture_decision.json first. If status is ENGINEERING_ALIGNMENT_HOLD, stop this step: do not print or improvise an arm adapter and do not run the fixed eye-to-hand procedure as though it calibrates a moving arm-mounted camera.
2. Select and document the actual camera-support route; do not infer an arm adapter, mast placement, or fastener length from the fallback illustration.
3. For the fixed-mast fallback only, attach the camera to the accepted Job 03C3 plate with measured hardware or straps and verify no screw bottoms in the camera body.
4. For the fixed-mast fallback only, mount the plate rigidly on the independent support so arm vibration cannot move the view.
5. Route USB with architecture-specific service loop, strain relief, bend, flex-life, snag, and clearance controls. A moving arm cable requires full-joint sweep evidence; the fixed fallback cable must remain clear of the robot and loading paths.
6. Create the known vision environment from the project root: run `py -3.10 -m venv .venv-vision`, `./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip`, and `./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r requirements-vision.txt`. Then run `./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe software_helpers/capture_camera_frames.py --help`, `./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe software_helpers/calibrate_camera_charuco.py --help`, and `./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe software_helpers/detect_apriltags.py --help`. Stop if any command fails.
7. Print the ChArUco board at 100 percent and verify its scale. Replace `BUILD_ID_HERE`, then capture 30 varied views at the locked 1920 x 1080 runtime resolution with `./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe software_helpers/capture_camera_frames.py --camera-index 0 --width 1920 --height 1080 --count 30 --prefix charuco --output-dir "BUILD_BY_STEP/13 - Mount and Calibrate Camera/06 - SAVE MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS/BUILD_ID_HERE/photos/charuco"`. Press SPACE only for a sharp, distinct pose; vary distance and tilt and cover the center, edges, and corners. If the camera index or runtime resolution differs, use the measured locked values consistently for both capture sets and calibration. Retain `capture_session.json`.
8. Calibrate with `./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe software_helpers/calibrate_camera_charuco.py --images "BUILD_BY_STEP/13 - Mount and Calibrate Camera/06 - SAVE MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS/BUILD_ID_HERE/photos/charuco/*.png" --definition fiducials/charuco_board_definition.json --output "BUILD_BY_STEP/13 - Mount and Calibrate Camera/06 - SAVE MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS/BUILD_ID_HERE/reports/camera_intrinsics.json" --preview-dir "BUILD_BY_STEP/13 - Mount and Calibrate Camera/06 - SAVE MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS/BUILD_ID_HERE/reports/charuco_previews"`. Retain the JSON and previews; at least 20 distinct views must be accepted and RMS reprojection must be no more than 1.0 px.
9. Frame the board so T0, T1, T2, T3, K0, and P0 remain visible, then capture the 20-pose acceptance set with `./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe software_helpers/capture_camera_frames.py --camera-index 0 --width 1920 --height 1080 --count 20 --prefix fov --output-dir "BUILD_BY_STEP/13 - Mount and Calibrate Camera/06 - SAVE MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS/BUILD_ID_HERE/photos/fov"`. Span the required empty-cell envelope plus the closest edge and corner views, use the same locked settings as calibration, and retain the second `capture_session.json`.
10. Run the detector over every FOV PNG with the accepted intrinsics and measured Step 12 map. Replace `BUILD_ID_HERE` and choose a new attempt name once, then run this complete PowerShell batch from the project root: `$step13 = "BUILD_BY_STEP/13 - Mount and Calibrate Camera/06 - SAVE MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS/BUILD_ID_HERE"; $attempt = "apriltag_attempt_01"; $sourceDir = Join-Path $step13 "photos/fov"; $reportDir = Join-Path $step13 ("reports/" + $attempt); $annotatedDir = Join-Path $step13 ("photos/" + $attempt); if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $reportDir) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $annotatedDir)) { throw "Choose a new attempt name; existing evidence is never overwritten." }; $frames = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $sourceDir -Filter "*.png" | Sort-Object Name); if ($frames.Count -lt 20) { throw "At least 20 FOV PNG files are required; found $($frames.Count)." }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $reportDir,$annotatedDir | Out-Null; $failed = @(); foreach ($frame in $frames) { $report = Join-Path $reportDir ($frame.BaseName + ".json"); $annotated = Join-Path $annotatedDir ($frame.BaseName + ".png"); & ./.venv-vision/Scripts/python.exe software_helpers/detect_apriltags.py --image $frame.FullName --calibration (Join-Path $step13 "reports/camera_intrinsics.json") --tag-map fiducials/apriltag_map.json --output $report --annotated $annotated --min-world-tags 4 --require-board-pose --require-tag T0 --require-tag T1 --require-tag T2 --require-tag T3 --require-tag K0 --require-tag P0; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $failed += $frame.Name } }; if ($failed.Count -gt 0) { throw ("AprilTag acceptance failed for: " + ($failed -join ", ")) }`. This produces one JSON report and one annotated image per source PNG, fails on fewer than 20 inputs or any nonzero detector result, and refuses to overwrite an earlier attempt. Every report must show an empty `missing_required_tags` list and a solved `board_pose`.
11. Lock focus, exposure, white balance if available, resolution, camera index, and support position. Record all settings, calibration-file SHA-256, valid/rejected view counts, reprojection errors, and the 20-pose detection table.

## STOP

> Stop while config/camera_architecture_decision.json is ENGINEERING_ALIGNMENT_HOLD. The user-intended arm-mounted architecture is not released by the fixed-camera illustration, mast files, plate, or eye-to-hand commands. After formal alignment, also stop if the exact support is unmeasured, the camera moves, a screw can bottom, the moving cable is unqualified, the calibrated transform method does not match the mount architecture, or any route-required target leaves its accepted view.
